title: Two seconds. That is all it took to make the ultimate decision
description: Most people spend a lifetime wondering what they would do in a split-second crisis. But when fate called, this United States Marine didn't hesitate. In the final two seconds of his life, faced with unimaginable danger, his instinct wasn't self-preservation—it was protecting the brothers standing beside him.

title: He Never Made It to His 20th Birthday… But He Earned a Place in History.
description: Born on December 27, 1990, in San Jose, California, Arden was known for his warm smile, kind heart, and unwavering loyalty to the people he loved. He enjoyed music, cars, video games, and spending time with his younger brothers. But beneath his easygoing personality was a young man with an unshakable desire to serve something greater than himself. Soon after graduating from high school, he answered America's call and earned the title of United States Marine.
